exposure: NICHD fetal heart rate categories (I, II, III)
Onset of abnormal fetal heart rate pattern
cohort: The study evaluated thirty fetal heart rate tracings from fetuses monitored in a labor ward.
finding: The Fetal Stress Index (FSI) minimum was significantly lower after the onset of abnormal FHR patterns in NICHD categories II and III compared to category I, suggesting its potential for evaluating fetal well-being.
